# Interface Contract

**Do not edit this file without telling the whole team.** This contract is what
lets three people build in parallel without blocking each other.

## 1. Content script → background (and background → server)

`PageScanRequest`

```jsonc
{
  "url": "https://news.example.com/article/123",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "id": "n1",                 // unique per page scan, generated by heuristics.js
      "tag": "div",
      "role": "complementary",
      "classes": ["ad-slot", "x7f2"],
      "origin": "https://ads.example.net",
      "size": "300x250",
      "position": "sticky",
      "textSnippet": "Your browser is out of date",
      "isIframe": false,
      "hasDownload": true,
      "hasPasswordField": false,
      "formAction": "",
      "redirectChain": ["https://a.example", "https://b.example"] // added by background
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules:
- Max 80 candidates per request.
- `id` is the only cross-file join key.
- Never send raw HTML. `textSnippet` is truncated to 160 chars.

## 2. Classifier → background → content script → popup

`Verdict[]`

```jsonc
[
  {
    "id": "n1",
    "verdict": "malicious",
    "severity": "high",
    "confidence": 0.94,
    "indicators": [
      "brand impersonation: 'Chrome' on chrome-update-secure.xyz",
      "urgency language: 'Your browser is out of date'",
      "download trigger without user gesture"
    ],
    "action": "block",
    "reason": "Fake browser-update lure directing to an executable download"
  }
]
```

Closed value sets:

| Field | Allowed values |
| --- | --- |
| `verdict` | `malicious`, `deceptive`, `phishing`, `unwanted_redirect`, `tracker`, `benign_ad`, `legit` |
| `severity` | `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `none` |
| `action` | `block`, `warn`, `allow` |

Invariants:
- Exactly one verdict per candidate `id` in the response.
- `action: "allow"` ⇒ element is revealed.
- Unknown/missing verdict ⇒ content script reveals the element (fail-safe).
- The server always returns a verdict for every candidate, even in fallback mode.

## 3. Background → popup (via `chrome.storage.session`)

Key: `scan_<tabId>`

```jsonc
{
  "tabId": 123,
  "url": "https://news.example.com/article/123",
  "at": 1762345678901,
  "verdicts": [ /* Verdict[] */ ]
}
```

## 3b. Protection state (`chrome.storage.local`)

Key: `enabled` (boolean, default `true`)

- Written by `popup.js` when the switch is toggled.
- Read by `content.js` on boot (every frame) and again on every change.
- `background.js` reads it before classifying and mirrors it in the toolbar
  badge (`OFF` when disabled).
- When `enabled` flips to `false`, content scripts reveal everything they hid
  and stop scanning. Flipping back to `true` clears the processed set and
  rescans the current DOM.

## 4. Change protocol

1. Announce in team chat what changes.
2. Update this file in the same commit.
3. Bump `version` in `extension/manifest.json` if the message shape changes.
